About the job
BettingJobs is working with a fast-growing sports betting technology business
to recruit a Senior Software Engineer for its Trading Technology team. You'll
build the backend engines behind real-time trading, risk management and core
platform services — systems where low latency, high throughput and reliability
are critical — as well as the React front-ends that surface them.

This is a role with genuine ownership: open-ended technical challenges, a real
say in architectural decisions, and the scope to shape team practices rather
than work through predefined tickets. It will suit an experienced .NET engineer
who enjoys distributed systems at scale and is equally comfortable delivering
polished, real-time user interfaces.

Responsibilities:
Design, develop and maintain efficient, reliable backend systems in Microsoft .NET
Build responsive React and TypeScript front-ends surfacing live trading and risk data
Integrate with message brokers (RabbitMQ), caching (Redis) and relational databases
Deploy and operate services using modern CI/CD, containerisation and cloud-native practices
Diagnose and resolve production issues using alerts, dashboards and log analysis
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to intermediate and junior developers
Contribute to code and design reviews, and write and maintain automated tests

Requirements:
Degree or diploma in Computer Science or a related field
5+ years' professional software development experience in Microsoft .NET
2+ years' front-end experience with a modern framework (React preferred; Angular
or Vue also valued) and strong TypeScript proficiency
Experience designing highly scalable, high-performance distributed systems
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the drive to work independently
in a fast-paced environment

Desirable:
Message-oriented middleware (RabbitMQ, Kafka), Redis, Kubernetes
Cloud platforms (Azure preferred, AWS also valued)
REST APIs, gRPC, WebSockets or SSE; observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry
Write-heavy real-time UIs — optimistic updates, concurrency and conflict resolution

Requirements added by the job poster
• 5+ years of work experience with .NET Core
• 5+ years of work experience with React.js
